tier1.headline: Your data is sold
tier1.quote: Under some local privacy laws, this may constitute a “sale” of personal information.

tier1.headline: Your biometrics are retained
tier1.quote: We take steps to permanently destroy any biometric data we maintain within the applicable timeframe specified by law or when it is no longer necessary to achieve the purpose for which it was collected or obtained, whichever occurs first.

tier1.headline: Your data trains AI
tier1.quote: We collect your personal information when you or others upload, share, send, or input that information through our Services or networks or when you or they communicate with us.

tier1.headline: Your profile is inferred
tier1.quote: Inferences from personal information: Profiles reflecting a person’s preferences, characteristics, psychological trends, predispositions, behavior, attitudes, intelligence, abilities, and aptitudes.

tier1.headline: Your data is from public records
tier1.quote: We may receive your personal information from third parties, such as our third-party business partners, including data brokers and advertising partners; your organizations; governmental agencies who publish public records; and other publicly or generally available sources, including online websites.

tier2.headline: Your data is shared broadly
tier2.quote: Affiliates within the Thomson Reuters group of companies.

tier2.headline: Your data is retained vaguely
tier2.quote: We retain personal information as required by our enterprise records retention schedule, which varies by Service, business function, country, record classes, and record types.

tier2.headline: Your precise location is collected
tier2.quote: Location data: Region, country, state, and coarse and precise geolocation data.

tier2.headline: Your behavior is profiled
tier2.quote: Inferences from personal information: Profiles reflecting a person’s preferences, characteristics, psychological trends, predispositions, behavior, attitudes, intelligence, abilities, and aptitudes.

tier2.headline: Your data targets ads
tier2.quote: Send you personalized and interest-based advertising and marketing.

tier2.headline: Your data is sent abroad
tier2.quote: When you interact with us, you authorize us to transfer your personal information outside of your home country, and you acknowledge the risk that we may transfer your personal information to countries that may provide less protection than your home country’s privacy laws, and we may not be able to prevent government authorities in some countries from accessing your personal information.

tier2.headline: Your data disclosed without warrant
tier2.quote: With law enforcement, government agencies, or other third parties in order to comply with any law, court order, legal request, or other legal process, as well as to enforce our agreements or protect the rights, property, or safety of our business, employees, customers, or others — including for the purposes of cybersecurity, fraud protection, and credit risk reduction.

tier2.headline: Your deletion rights are limited
tier2.quote: Important : These rights are not absolutely guaranteed and there are several exceptions where we may not have an obligation to fulfill your request.
